title: cleanup: CLI parse_slot_id() helper to remove strtoul repetition
description: The strtoul validation pattern (errno=0; strtoul; check errno, check end==str, check *end\!='\0') is repeated three times in wp11_cli.c (cmd_list_keys ~line 274, cmd_attest ~line 1427, cmd_list_mechanisms ~line 1495). Each copy is also missing the range check against WOLFP11_CFG_MAX_SLOTS (see wolfP11-g5j3). Extract a static helper parse_slot_id(str, out) that performs all validation in one place. Fixes the range check once rather than three times.
